messages:
meera: Quick follow-up from today's model-versioning RFC meeting. proposing a tiny addition to rollout metadata: a migration_score + soft eviction params to help the runtime prefer newer stable variants for slow-moving sticky refs. thoughts?

jordan: sounds useful. define ranges and defaults?

samir: +1. propose migration_score 0-100, higher = more candidate for rollforward. also a stability_score 0-100 from evals so runtime can penalize new noisy variants.

ophelia: ops concern: some customers depend on extremely sticky refs (long sessions). need a soft_ttl and an opt-out flag for enterprise tenants.

meera: sketch of fields: 
```json
{
  "variant_id": "rw-model-7b-v3",
  "migration_score": 55,
  "stability_score": 92,
  "soft_ttl_seconds": 7200,
  "grace_window_ms": 20000,
  "auto_evict": true,
  "reason_short": "perf+latency improvements",
  "eval_ref": "evals/2026-03/promptset-23"
}
```

jordan: grace_window_ms meaning?

meera: time window to accept simultaneous probes during a rollforward before making strict selection; helps with clock skew/queued requests. default 20s.

samir: runtime scoring idea: migration_priority = migration_score - (100 - stability_score). i.e. a migration_score of 60 and stability 80 => priority 40. tie-breaker: canary_pct then last_updated_ts.

ophelia: expose Prefer-Stable client header so certain clients can ask to only use variants with stability_score >= X. Also provide compact_hint header for mobile: e.g. compact_hint=\"ms:60,ss:85,ttl:3600\".

jordan: defaults suggestion: migration_score=50, stability_score=100 for existing variants, soft_ttl_seconds=3600, grace_window_ms=30000, auto_evict=true.

ophelia: eviction backoff schedule: attempt offsets = [0s, 30s, 2m, 10m, 1h], multiply base by grace_window_ms/1000. include eviction_attempt_id in logs for tracing.

infra-bot: autoscaler bumped pool-a at 1777654400, no routing changes detected. :white_check_mark:

meera: action items: 1) add fields above to rollout metadata schema. 2) append scoring formula & tie-breakers to the RFC appendix. 3) add Console UI hooks for reason_short and eval_ref. 4) docs for Prefer-Stable + compact_hint. ophelia to own ops playbook for enterprise overrides.

jordan: no blockers from me.

samir: I'll draft the runtime change and tests for scoring.

ophelia: will write the playbook and add a short dashboard widget for migration_priority.

meera: If no objections by EOD I'll fold into the RFC. thanks all :thumbsup:
